results.reason: The reading captures the wish to book a short planning meeting tomorrow morning and the team's reason for wanting to align.
The shed, boulder, kid, and goat are separate things on the farm; the circuit instead makes the latter entities appositions of one another.
The circuit attaches back to taking both coordinated sets of steps, although only the first two steps are backward and the second two are forward.
Wider is attached as an adverb to the on relation, rather than expressing the requested wider property of the dots.
The imperative to remember contains the speaker's wish for an old man figure.
The facing clause is attached to the face rather than the boy, and the boy, deer, girl, and cat are incorrectly treated as appositions rather than separate scene elements.
The circuit makes smack an entity and places it between the horse and tree, rather than placing the standing farmer there; it also treats the farmer and trough as appositions of the horse.
The when clause is attached to the last three rather than to the instruction to turn the groups when the addressee gets a chance.
